title: अंश ५ · अध्याय ११

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
मखे प्रतिहते शक्रो मैत्रेयातिरुषान्वितः ।
संवर्त्तकं नाम गणं तोयदानामथाऽब्रवीत् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
makhe pratihate śakro maitreyātiruṣānvitaḥ |
saṃvarttakaṃ nāma gaṇaṃ toyadānāmathā'bravīt || 1 ||

items.text:
भोभो मेघा निशम्यैतद्वचनं गदतो मम ।
आज्ञानंतरमेवाशु क्रियतामविचारितम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
bhobho meghā niśamyaitadvacanaṃ gadato mama |
ājñānaṃtaramevāśu kriyatāmavicāritam || 2 ||

items.text:
नंदगोपस्सुदुर्बुद्धिर्गोपैरन्यैस्सहायवान् ।
कृष्णाश्रयं बलाध्मातो मखभंगमचीकरत् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
naṃdagopassudurbuddhirgopairanyaissahāyavān |
kṛṣṇāśrayaṃ balādhmāto makhabhaṃgamacīkarat || 3 ||

items.text:
आजीवो याः परस्तेषां गावस्तस्य च कारणम् ।
तागावो वृष्टिपातेन पीड्यन्तां वचनान्मम ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
ājīvo yāḥ parasteṣāṃ gāvastasya ca kāraṇam |
tāgāvo vṛṣṭipātena pīḍyantāṃ vacanānmama || 4 ||

items.text:
अहमप्यद्रि शृंगाभं तुंगमारुह्य वारणम् ।
साहाय्यं वः करिष्यामि वाय्वम्बूत्सर्गयोजितम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
ahamapyadri śṛṃgābhaṃ tuṃgamāruhya vāraṇam |
sāhāyyaṃ vaḥ kariṣyāmi vāyvambūtsargayojitam || 5 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्याज्ञप्तास्ततस्तेन मुमुचुस्ते बलाहकाः ।
वातवर्षं महाभीममभावाय गवां द्विज ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
ityājñaptāstatastena mumucuste balāhakāḥ |
vātavarṣaṃ mahābhīmamabhāvāya gavāṃ dvija || 6 ||

items.text:
ततः क्षणेन पृथिवी ककुभॐबरमेव च ।
एकं धारामहासारपूरेणनाभवन्मुने ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ kṣaṇena pṛthivī kakubhaoṃbarameva ca |
ekaṃ dhārāmahāsārapūreṇanābhavanmune || 7 ||

items.text:
विद्युल्लताकषाघातत्रस्तैरिव घनैर्घनम् ।
नादापूरितदिक्चक्रैर्धारासारमपात्यत ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
vidyullatākaṣāghātatrastairiva ghanairghanam |
nādāpūritadikcakrairdhārāsāramapātyata || 8 ||

items.text:
अंधकारीकृते लोके वर्षद्भिरनिशं घनैः ।
अधश्चोर्ध्वं च तिर्यक् च जगदाप्यमिवाभवत् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
aṃdhakārīkṛte loke varṣadbhiraniśaṃ ghanaiḥ |
adhaścordhvaṃ ca tiryak ca jagadāpyamivābhavat || 9 ||

items.text:
गावस्तु तेन पतता वर्षवातेन वेगिना ।
धूताः प्राणाञ्जहुस्सन्नत्रिकसक्थिशिरोधराः ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
gāvastu tena patatā varṣavātena veginā |
dhūtāḥ prāṇāñjahussannatrikasakthiśirodharāḥ || 10 ||

items.text:
क्रोडेन वत्सानाक्रम्य तस्थुरन्या महामुने ।
गावो विवत्साश्च कृता वारिपूरेण चापराः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
kroḍena vatsānākramya tasthuranyā mahāmune |
gāvo vivatsāśca kṛtā vāripūreṇa cāparāḥ || 11 ||

items.text:
वत्साश्च दीनवदना वातकंपितकंधराः ।
त्राहित्राहीत्यल्पशब्दाः कृष्णमूचुरिवातुराः ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
vatsāśca dīnavadanā vātakaṃpitakaṃdharāḥ |
trāhitrāhītyalpaśabdāḥ kṛṣṇamūcurivāturāḥ || 12 ||

items.text:
ततस्तद्गोकुलं सर्वं गोगोपीगोपसंकुलम् ।
अतीवार्त्तं हरिर्दृष्ट्वा मैत्रेयाचिंतयत्तदा ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
tatastadgokulaṃ sarvaṃ gogopīgopasaṃkulam |
atīvārttaṃ harirdṛṣṭvā maitreyāciṃtayattadā || 13 ||

items.text:
एतत्कृतं महेंद्रे ण मखभंगविरोधिना ।
तदेतदखिलं गोष्ठं त्रातव्यमधुना मया ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
etatkṛtaṃ maheṃdre ṇa makhabhaṃgavirodhinā |
tadetadakhilaṃ goṣṭhaṃ trātavyamadhunā mayā || 14 ||

items.text:
इममद्रि महं धैर्यादुत्पाट्योरुशिखाघनम् ।
धारयिष्यामि गोष्ठस्य पृथुच्छत्रमिवोपरि ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
imamadri mahaṃ dhairyādutpāṭyoruśikhāghanam |
dhārayiṣyāmi goṣṭhasya pṛthucchatramivopari || 15 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इति कृत्वामतिं कृष्णो गोवर्द्धनमहीधरम् ।
उत्पाट्यैककरेणैव धारयामास लीलया ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
iti kṛtvāmatiṃ kṛṣṇo govarddhanamahīdharam |
utpāṭyaikakareṇaiva dhārayāmāsa līlayā || 16 ||

items.text:
गोपांश्चाह हसञ्छौरिस्समुत्पाटितभूधरः ।
विशध्वमत्रत्वरिताः कृतं वर्षनिवारणम् ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
gopāṃścāha hasañchaurissamutpāṭitabhūdharaḥ |
viśadhvamatratvaritāḥ kṛtaṃ varṣanivāraṇam || 17 ||

items.text:
सुनिवातेषु देश्षोउ! यथा जोषमिहास्यताम् ।
प्रविश्यतां न भेतव्यं गिरिपाताच्च निर्भयैः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
sunivāteṣu deśṣou! yathā joṣamihāsyatām |
praviśyatāṃ na bhetavyaṃ giripātācca nirbhayaiḥ || 18 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्तास्तेन ते गोपा विविशुर्गोधनैस्सह ।
शकटारोपितैर्भांडैर्गोप्यश्चासारपीडिताः ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktāstena te gopā viviśurgodhanaissaha |
śakaṭāropitairbhāṃḍairgopyaścāsārapīḍitāḥ || 19 ||

items.text:
कृष्णोपि तं दधारैव शैलमत्यंतनिश्चलम् ।
व्रजौकवासिभिर्हर्षविस्मिताक्षैर्निरीक्षितः ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
kṛṣṇopi taṃ dadhāraiva śailamatyaṃtaniścalam |
vrajaukavāsibhirharṣavismitākṣairnirīkṣitaḥ || 20 ||

items.text:
गोपगोपीजनैर्हृष्टैः प्रीतिविस्तारितेक्षणैः ।
संस्तूयमानचरितः कृष्णश्शैलमधारयत् ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
gopagopījanairhṛṣṭaiḥ prītivistāritekṣaṇaiḥ |
saṃstūyamānacaritaḥ kṛṣṇaśśailamadhārayat || 21 ||

items.text:
सप्तरात्रं महामेघा ववर्षुर्नंदगोकुले ।
इंद्रे ण चोदिता विप्र गोपानां नाशकारिणा ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
saptarātraṃ mahāmeghā vavarṣurnaṃdagokule |
iṃdre ṇa coditā vipra gopānāṃ nāśakāriṇā || 22 ||

items.text:
ततो धृते महाशैले परित्राते च गोकुले ।
मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञो बलभिद्वारयामास तान्घनान् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
tato dhṛte mahāśaile paritrāte ca gokule |
mithyāpratijño balabhidvārayāmāsa tānghanān || 23 ||

items.text:
व्यभ्रे नभसि देवेंद्रे वितथात्मवचस्यथ ।
निष्क्रम्य गोकुलं हृष्टं स्वस्थानं पुनरागमत् ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
vyabhre nabhasi deveṃdre vitathātmavacasyatha |
niṣkramya gokulaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ svasthānaṃ punarāgamat || 24 ||

items.text:
मुमोच कृष्णोपि तदा गोवर्द्धनमहाचलम् ।
स्वस्थाने विस्मितमुखैर्दृष्टस्तैस्तु व्रजौकसैः ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
mumoca kṛṣṇopi tadā govarddhanamahācalam |
svasthāne vismitamukhairdṛṣṭastaistu vrajaukasaiḥ || 25 ||

en_chapter: Parāçara said—Being thus disappointed of offerings in the sacrifice, O Maitreya, Sakra, greatly angry, addressed the attendant clouds called Samvarttaka saying—"O ye clouds! hear what I say and do ye speedily execute without any judgment my behests. The foolish cow-herd Nanda and his companions, relying upon the protection of Krishna have withheld the usual offerings to us. Now therefore, distress the cattle, with wind and rain at my command, that are their subsistance and whence their occupation is derived. Ascending my elephant, huge as a mountain summit, I will give you assistance in strengthening the tempest".

Parsara said:—O twice-born one, being thus commanded by the celestial-chief, the clouds came down in a fearful storm of rain and wind to destroy the cattle. In a moment, the earth the points of the horizon and the sky were all blended into one by the heavy and incessant showers. Being afraid of the lightning's scourge, the clouds filled the quarters with their muttering and pouring down uninterrupted torrents. The clouds pouring down waters day and night, the earth was filled with darkness; and above below and on every side the world was filled with water. The cattle, pelted by the storm, shrank cowering into the smallest size or gave up their breath. Some covered their calves with flanks and some saw their young ones carried away by the flood. Trembling in the wind, the calves cast their piteous looks at their mothers or begged, in low moans, as if, the help of Krishna. Beholding all Gokula moved with terror and cow-herds and cow-herdesses and cattle stricken with consternations, Hari thus thought "This is the work of Mahendra, who has been offended for withholding sacrifices from me; it is therefore my duty to defend this village of herdsmen. I will uplift this spacious mountain from its snowy base and hold it up as a large umbrella over the cow-pens". Having thus made up his mind, Krishna immediately upheld the mountain Govardhana with one hand as if in sport, and said to the cow-herds—"Behold the mountain is on high; enter beneath it speedily, and it will shelter you from the storm; here you will be secure and happy in places defended from the wind; enter speedily and fear not that the mountain will fall". Thereupon, all the people with their cattle, wagons, goods, women, afflicted as they were by rain, went to the shelter of the mountain which he held steadily over their heads; and Krishna, as he supported the mountain, was contemplated with delight and astonishment by the inhabitants of Vraja. As his eyes expanded with joy and wonder, the cow-herds and cow-herdesses sang his glories. For seven days and nights did the vast clouds, despatched by Indra, pour down showers upon the Gokula of Nanda, to destroy the dwellers, but they were protected by the height of the mountain. And being baffled in his purpose, the Indra, the destroyer of Bala, ordered the clouds to cease. The threats of Indra having been fruitless and the sky clear, all the inhabitants of Gokula came out from the shelter and went back to their respective habitations. Then Krishna, in the presence of the inhabitants of the forests filled with surprise, restored the great mountain Govardhana to its original site.
